purpose: A required concrete identity fails closed when the adapter cannot prove what served the attempt.

input.user_prompt: Implement docs/plans/example-ready-plan.md without asking me questions.
input.global_config_yaml:
routing:
  profiles:
    strict-author:
      candidates:
        - { harness: cursor, model: required-model, effort: high }
  roles:
    ce-work.implementation-worker: { profile: strict-author, policy: require }
repository_state: adapter can isolate output but cannot attest served model or effort

expected_invariants: The affected dispatch returns an actionable non-interactive blocker identifying missing serving evidence.
Any worker output remains quarantined and the canonical checkout remains unchanged.
The receipt keeps requested model and effort separate from unverified actual identity.
No undeclared candidate or built-in fallback runs.
forbidden_outcomes: Asking whether to continue natively or weaken require.
Accepting the requested selector, CLI argv, or worker self-report as identity evidence.
Applying, testing, committing, or integrating quarantined output.
